scope: Read-only public 21st.dev references for compact mobile JOYRENT hero CTA. No source/build/deploy changes, no installation, no paid tools.

references.title: Interactive Hover Button
references.author: Dillion Verma
references.observed: Rounded full button. Hover transitions duration 300ms. Default text translates 48px out and fades; duplicate label with arrow translates in. Decorative dot grows to 1.8x full button as primary background.
references.adaptation: Use compact pill and inset caret interaction only. Keep one stable accessible label, do not swap/duplicate text or expand dot.

references.title: Shiny Button
references.author: Dillion Verma
references.observed: Animate CSS --x 100% to -100% as looping mask/shine with repeat Infinity and repeatDelay 1. Spring entrance scale .8 to 1; tap scale .95. Hover shadow.
references.adaptation: Do not carry looping text mask, bouncing entrance or glow into hero. Subtle pressed feedback alone may be adapted.

references.title: Shimmer Button
references.author: Dillion Verma
references.observed: Conic-gradient perimeter light continuously slides and spins. Blur 2px and inset shadow, hover/active inset-shadow changes. Active button translateY 1px.
references.adaptation: Perpetual perimeter animation suits separately requested delivery CTA but adds unnecessary motion to hero. Do not use on hero.

access.method: Direct HTML/metadata/public CDN GET through existing Desktop Commander connector. Cloud proxy blocked 21st.dev CONNECT (403). Public previews and compiled component bundles accessed successfully.
access.installation: Metadata says official shadcn registry requires API_KEY_21ST; free limited installs, paid unlimited. No API key/install requested or used. Public compiled bundles were inspected as references; authored TSX registry not fetched.

recommendation.basis: Restrained adaptation of Interactive Hover Button interaction and silhouette, using existing JOYRENT design tokens and Phosphor CaretRight; no dependency needed.
recommendation.layout: Single ivory pill, min-height 48px; 14–15px semibold stable text; gap 12px; 26–28px inset circular caret container. Horizontal balance, consistent touch target.
recommendation.desktopHover: Only @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine). Caret translates +2px in 160–200ms ease-out. Mild inset-circle background/border shift. No large shadow or layout movement.
recommendation.touchPressed: Scale .98 or translateY 1px, brief and restrained. Keep secondary rates link separate with adequate gap.
recommendation.keyboard: Native anchor/button, visible focus ring, no focus/layout movement, one accessible label.
recommendation.reducedMotion: Disable transforms/transitions/animation; keep static color and focus feedback.
recommendation.avoid: Perpetual hero shimmer, glowing background, spring entrance, duplicate sliding labels, large caret displacement.
